# Issue templates (binarygeek119/seerr)

When someone opens a new issue on this repo, GitHub shows:

| Template | Use for |
| -------- | ------- |
| **Bug Report** | Something broken in this fork |
| **Feature Request** | New idea for this fork |
| **Documentation** | README / repo docs fixes |
| **Maintenance** | CI, Docker, dependencies |

**Not for support:** use [Discord](https://discord.gg/xmNs5ecFX) for help and setup questions.

**Upstream Seerr:** [seerr-team/seerr](https://github.com/seerr-team/seerr/issues) — use that for bugs in official releases, not this fork.
